name: 音声入力付き検索欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE Lighthouse catalog component, LH01-0001 音声入力付き検索欄.
Create one faithful high-resolution visual redesign of the single horizontal voice-enabled search field shown in input image 1. Input 1 is our saved Japanese component preview and is the authority for exact content and layout. Input 2 is the original Google Maps source screen, used only to confirm anatomy: back chevron, empty location search placeholder, microphone. Input 3 is the owner-approved bus design, a STYLE reference for pure white surfaces, fine neutral outlines, soft elevation and restrained craft; do not copy any bus content, map, labels, numbers or extra controls.
Preserve the exact Japanese placeholder "地域や施設を検索". The component contains ONLY a left back chevron, that placeholder, and a right microphone outline icon. Preserve left-to-right ordering, compact pill outline and empty/unfocused visible state. No heading, caption, separate search button, results, keyboard, device frame, branding or new features.
Typography: Japanese Meiryo Regular, logical 14px with 24px line-height and zero tracking, scaled uniformly for crisp output; preserve established relative size and single line. Placeholder neutral secondary gray. Icons consistent slate #526173, uniform outline weight. Background pure #FFFFFF; control white with fine neutral border, gently rounded capsule and very soft downward shadow. No mint wash or colored glow.
Accent decision: original search field has neutral utility icons and no selected state or primary filled action. Keep both utility icons slate; omit additional colored accents because none conveys a real state. Do not invent a green microphone button or recolor the field.
Composition: wide landscape white canvas around 3:1, a single compact search field centered with modest clean margins, approximately 94% canvas width, no unrelated material. Flat frontal UI render, no perspective. Make all exact Japanese glyphs sharp, spacing deliberate, controls balanced and unclipped. This is a static design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画面と保存モックを実画像で確認。対象検索欄は無彩色。戻ると音声入力はスレート、機能的な選択状態がないため追加アクセントなし。生成後の日本語・3要素・順序・白面・輪郭・欠けなしを視認。原モックより文字と線が太く見えるため細さの修正が必要。フォント一致、操作、所有者承認、実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
